name: Lough Derg
lore: Lough Derg: Mag Mell, Tir na mBeo and Mardagh round the red lake. The dead stir in the barrow and the haunted wood at night, the curmudgeons rob the harvest, the hill pests feud, the fae guard their woods, and the Dergans gather on their island.

chains.title: The Summoner's Muster
chains.hint: Green fire flickers over the old barrow by Mag Mell...

stages.name: The Dead Rise
stages.objective: Put down the dead climbing out of the barrow
stages.announce: The old barrow is open, and the dead are climbing out of it in rows. Someone is calling them.
stages.success: The ranks break. In the barrow's mouth a robed figure lifts its staff, and the ground answers.
stages.fail: There are too many. The dead stand in ranks round the barrow, waiting for their orders.

stages.name: The Summoner
stages.objective: Kill the Summoner before his army is ready
stages.announce: The Summoner stands in the barrow's mouth, raising the dead to march on Mag Mell. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Summoner falls and the dead fall with him. On his body: a seal of red wax pressed with the mark of the Dergan warlord on the island.
stages.fail: The Summoner's army marches. They stop on the road to Mag Mell and hold it.

stages.name: The Skeletal Pawns Hold the Road to Mag Mell
stages.objective: Drive the skeletal pawns off the road to Mag Mell
stages.announce: With The Summoner's Muster lost, the skeletal pawns have spread down onto the road to Mag Mell and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The skeletal pawns are gone from the road to Mag Mell. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Fiona, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Fiona has come out to set the road to Mag Mell right. The skeletal pawns are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Mag Mell is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The skeletal pawns break and scatter. The road to Mag Mell is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Fiona falls, and the skeletal pawns take the road back.

chains.title: The Ghostly Siabra
chains.hint: Pale shapes move among the haunted trees north-east of the lake...

stages.name: Protect Niamh the Lorekeeper
stages.objective: Keep Niamh alive while she reads the old rites
stages.announce: Niamh the Lorekeeper has come to the edge of the haunted wood to lay its dead to rest. The dead don't want to go.
stages.thanks: The words are said. Now we must go in and finish it - the one who keeps them here is in the wood.
stages.success: Niamh finishes the rite at the wood's edge. The way in is open.
stages.fail: Niamh falls, and the haunting deepens.

stages.name: Clear the Grey Wood
stages.objective: Put down the restless dead among the trees
stages.announce: Into the grey wood - the dead are thick between the trees tonight.
stages.success: The wood goes quiet. Then something old answers from its heart.
stages.fail: The dead hold the wood tonight.

stages.name: The Siabra Revenant
stages.objective: Defeat the Siabra Revenant
stages.announce: The Siabra Revenant rises at the heart of the haunted wood. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Revenant comes apart like mist in the morning. The haunting will be thinner for a while.
stages.fail: The Revenant drives you from the wood, and the dead spill out onto the farm road.

stages.name: The Ghostly Siabras Hold the Farm Road
stages.objective: Drive the ghostly siabras off the farm road
stages.announce: With The Ghostly Siabra lost, the ghostly siabras have spread down onto the farm road and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The ghostly siabras are gone from the farm road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Ruadh, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Ruadh has come out to set the farm road right. The ghostly siabras are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Tir na mBeo is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The ghostly siabras break and scatter. The farm road is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Ruadh falls, and the ghostly siabras take the road back.

chains.title: The Curmudgeon Harvest
chains.hint: Guardian Fionn is looking for help in Mag Mell.

giver.name: Guardian Fionn
giver.greet: The curmudgeons have stripped the north fields bare and carted the harvest off to their store. We're going to take it back. Will you come? Say when you're [ready].
giver.reply: Good. Stay close - they will have watchers out. With me!
giver.busy: We've only just come back. Give my people a while to rest, then find me again.

stages.name: The Road to the Curmudgeons' Store
stages.objective: Go with Guardian Fionn to the curmudgeons' store
stages.announce: Guardian Fionn leads the way along the north shore to the curmudgeons' store.
stages.success: Guardian Fionn reaches the store. "There's our grain. Take it back!"
stages.fail: Guardian Fionn falls on the road.

stages.name: Clear the Curmudgeons' Store
stages.objective: Drive the curmudgeons out of their store
stages.announce: Clear the store!
stages.success: The store is ours - but a cart heaped with stolen grain is already rattling off east!
stages.fail: They hold the store.

stages.name: Stop the Grain Cart
stages.objective: Stop the stolen-grain cart before it reaches the curmudgeon camp
stages.announce: The grain cart is making for the curmudgeons' camp at the Bri Leith edge. Stop it before it gets there!
stages.success: The cart is stopped, the grain spilled across the road - and from the trees comes a furious bellow.
stages.fail: The cart rolls into the curmudgeon camp. The harvest is gone, and the curmudgeons are bolder for it.

stages.name: Grogan the Curmudgeon King
stages.objective: Defeat Grogan the Curmudgeon King
stages.announce: Grogan the Curmudgeon King has come for his grain himself. Bring friends.
stages.success: Grogan falls. Mag Mell eats this winter.
stages.fail: Grogan drives you off, and his curmudgeons take the mill road.

stages.name: The Curmudgeons Hold the Mill Road
stages.objective: Drive the curmudgeons off the mill road
stages.announce: The curmudgeons have the whole mill road now, and every cart that comes down it.
stages.success: The mill road is free. The miller will want her carts back.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Miller Brigid, who is righting the overturned carts
stages.announce: Miller Brigid is righting the overturned carts. The curmudgeons are coming back!
stages.thanks: "The carts are rolling again - and not to the curmudgeons' store this time!"
stages.success: The curmudgeon harvesters break and scatter. The road to Mag Mell is open again.
stages.fail: Miller Brigid falls, and the curmudgeon harvesters take the road back.

chains.title: The Dergan War Bands
chains.hint: War drums beat in the south-east woods...

stages.name: Battle at the Bri Leith Edge
stages.objective: Break the battle between the Dergans and the curmudgeons
stages.announce: A Dergan war band has fallen on the curmudgeons' camp at the Bri Leith edge. Whoever wins will be on the roads next.
stages.success: Both sides reel back. Out of the Dergan line strides their war chief.
stages.fail: The Dergans carry the field, and march for the east shore road.

stages.name: War Chief Fiachra
stages.objective: Defeat War Chief Fiachra
stages.announce: War Chief Fiachra of the Dergans takes the field himself. Bring friends.
stages.success: Fiachra falls. He carries orders from the island - the warlord is gathering his strength.
stages.fail: Fiachra's war band marches on the east shore road.

stages.name: The Dergans Hold the East Shore Road
stages.objective: Drive the Dergans off the east shore road
stages.announce: With The Dergan War Bands lost, the Dergans have spread down onto the east shore road and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The Dergans are gone from the east shore road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Fiona, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Fiona has come out to set the east shore road right. The Dergans are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Mag Mell is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The Dergans break and scatter. The east shore road is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Fiona falls, and the Dergans take the road back.

chains.title: Highway Robbery
chains.hint: Shouts for help on the road south of Mag Mell...

stages.name: Save the Pedlar
stages.objective: Keep Bram the pedlar alive
stages.announce: Villainous youths have jumped Bram the pedlar on the road south of Mag Mell!
stages.thanks: They went that way - west, into the woods. Their leader's a big lout who calls himself Mog.
stages.success: The robbers scatter into the woods.
stages.fail: Bram is left in the road with empty pockets, or worse.

stages.name: Mog the Highwayman
stages.objective: Find and defeat Mog the Highwayman
stages.announce: Mog the Highwayman is waiting in the woods with Bram's goods.
stages.success: Mog goes down. Bram gets his goods back - and the gang will think twice about that road.
stages.fail: Mog gets away with the loot.

chains.title: The Hill War
chains.hint: The hill pests are at war again north of Mag Mell...

stages.name: Battle for the Spring
stages.objective: Break up the battle for the hill spring
stages.announce: The spraggons have come for the hill spring, and the rat boys and lucradans have joined up to stop them. Nobody gets water while this lasts.
stages.success: Both sides scatter - all but the big spraggonoll who started it.
stages.fail: The pests fight on, and the spring runs muddy.

stages.name: Grubb Bigfist
stages.objective: Defeat Grubb Bigfist, the spraggonoll who started it
stages.announce: Grubb Bigfist won't give up the spring. Bring friends.
stages.success: Grubb runs howling. The spring is the hills' again - for now.
stages.fail: Grubb holds the spring.

chains.title: Mushrooms for Mardagh
chains.hint: Ailbhe the alchemist is looking for help at the edge of the fae woods.

giver.name: Ailbhe the Alchemist
giver.greet: Glowcaps! The fae woods are full of them this season, and I need a basketful for my brews. The fae don't like sharing. Will you pick some for me? Say when you're [ready].
giver.reply: Bring them back to me here as you pick them - I'll count them in. And mind the little folk.
giver.busy: I'm still brewing the last batch. Come back a little later.
giver.thanks: Marvellous. These will make a fine brew - and here's something for your trouble.

stages.name: Glowcaps for Ailbhe
stages.objective: Pick glowcaps in the fae woods (click them) and bring them to Ailbhe at the woods' edge
stages.announce: The glowcaps glimmer between the trees of the fae woods. The fae are watching.
stages.success: Ailbhe's basket is full - and the fae have noticed what's missing.
stages.fail: The light fades and the glowcaps close up for the night.

stages.name: The Fear Dearg
stages.objective: Defeat the Fear Dearg, who wants his mushrooms back
stages.announce: The Fear Dearg - the little red man of the woods - comes for his glowcaps. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Fear Dearg vanishes with a laugh. Ailbhe gets her brew.
stages.fail: The Fear Dearg scatters the basket.

chains.title: The Hunt for Old Redjaw
chains.hint: Hunters in Mag Mell talk of a huge red hound seen on the east plains...

stages.name: Old Redjaw
stages.objective: Track down and kill Old Redjaw
stages.announce: Old Redjaw is out on the east plains - follow the tracks. He doesn't stay in one place.
stages.success: Old Redjaw is down. They'll be telling this one in Mag Mell for years.
stages.fail: Old Redjaw slips away into the woods.

chains.title: The Taking of Dergan Island
chains.hint: The roane are waiting on the shore to carry a war band to Dergan Island.

giver.name: Muirne of the Roane
giver.greet: The roane will carry you over - but not a handful of you. Ruadhan has the whole island. Gather a war band here, eight at least, and when you are, tell me you're [ready to cross].
giver.reply: Into the water, all of you - hold on to us and don't let go. To the island!
giver.busy: We're not ready to go again yet. Rest, and gather.
giver.thanks: The island is free. The roane will remember this for a hundred years.
giver.regret: Back to the water! We'll try again when we're stronger.

stages.name: The Landing
stages.objective: Clear the beach under the siabra archers
stages.announce: The roane bring you up onto the north beach of Dergan Island. Arrows come down from the rocks - clear the beach!
stages.success: The beach is ours. Above it, three ward-stones hum with siabra magic - the island's shield.
stages.fail: The war band is driven back into the water.

stages.name: The Wards
stages.objective: Take all three ward-stones and hold them together
stages.announce: Siabra keepers hold three ward-stones - west, east and south. Take all three at once: split up!
stages.success: The last ward-stone cracks. The siabra shield over the island is gone - and Ruadhan knows it.
stages.fail: The wards hold. The war band falls back to the beach and the roane.

stages.name: Ruadhan of the Red Hand
stages.objective: Defeat Ruadhan, warlord of the Red Lake
stages.announce: Ruadhan of the Red Hand comes down from his hall with Nock and his tusslers. 'Mag Mell's dogs, on MY island?'
stages.success: Ruadhan falls, and the Red Hand banner with him. His warriors are still coming up from the shore!
stages.fail: Ruadhan holds his island. The war band breaks for the water.

stages.name: Hold the Island
stages.objective: Keep the Mag Mell standard standing
stages.announce: Plant the standard! The last of Ruadhan's warriors are coming up from the beaches - hold!
stages.thanks: The standard stands. Dergan Island is Hibernian.
stages.success: The last of them break and swim for it. Dergan Island is taken!
stages.fail: The standard falls. The war band is driven off.

chains.title: Raiders on the Beach
chains.hint: Dergan boats are putting out from the east shore, making for the island camp...

stages.name: Defend the Camp
stages.objective: Keep Camp-Warden Dara alive
stages.announce: Dergan boats are on the beaches! Keep the camp-warden alive and the camp stands.
stages.thanks: They're running back to their boats. Well held!
stages.success: The raiders break and swim for it. The camp stands.
stages.fail: Camp-Warden Dara falls, and the camp with her.

chains.title: The Second Raid
chains.hint: More Dergan boats this time - they mean to take the camp back...

stages.name: Defend the Camp
stages.objective: Keep Camp-Warden Dara alive
stages.announce: Dergan boats are on the beaches! Keep the camp-warden alive and the camp stands.
stages.thanks: They're running back to their boats. Well held!
stages.success: The raiders break and swim for it. The camp stands.
stages.fail: Camp-Warden Dara falls, and the camp with her.

chains.title: The Third Raid
chains.hint: The lake is thick with Dergan boats. The camp's bells are ringing...

stages.name: Defend the Camp
stages.objective: Keep Camp-Warden Dara alive
stages.announce: Dergan boats are on the beaches! Keep the camp-warden alive and the camp stands.
stages.thanks: They're running back to their boats. Well held!
stages.success: The raiders break and swim for it. The camp stands.
stages.fail: Camp-Warden Dara falls, and the camp with her.

chains.title: Ruadhan Returns
chains.hint: A red sail on the lake: Ruadhan has come back for his island, with every Dergan he could find.

stages.name: The Red Tide
stages.objective: Keep Camp-Warden Dara alive against the whole Dergan host
stages.announce: They come from every beach at once. Hold the camp!
stages.success: The first tide breaks - and Ruadhan himself wades ashore.
stages.fail: The camp is overrun.

stages.name: Ruadhan Returned
stages.objective: Defeat Ruadhan again
stages.announce: 'You took my island. I've come to take it back.' Ruadhan of the Red Hand, with his whole host behind him.
stages.success: Ruadhan falls again. The island holds - for now.
stages.fail: Ruadhan stands over the camp. Dergan Island is lost.

siege.name: Dergan Island
siege.open_text: Hear me! Hibernian resolve is high - Ruadhan's island can be taken! Muirne of the roane waits on the east shore, by Ronan of the Roane, to carry a war band across. If no one leads them within the hour, the war band will go without you.
siege.taken_text: Dergan Island is ours! The roane and the Guard are making camp on it - go and see.
siege.repelled_text: The assault on Dergan Island has been thrown back. The Dergans grow bolder.
siege.raid_text: Dergan raiders are making for the island camp!
siege.held_text: The Dergans' raid on the island is beaten off. The camp stands.
siege.fall_text: Dergan Island has fallen. The camp is gone, Ruadhan's warriors hold it again - and Mag Mell must rebuild its resolve.

camp_npcs.name: Quartermaster Eoghan
camp_npcs.greet: Island-only stock, for those who took it and those who hold it. The Guard looks after its own.

camp_npcs.name: Ronnat the Sealwife
camp_npcs.greet: Roane-made, every piece. We don't sell to just anyone - but you're not just anyone, not now.

camp_npcs.name: Alchemist Saoirse
camp_npcs.greet: Glowcap, mere-dew, fae-fire. Mardagh's best, brought all the way out here for you. Coin, mind - not marks.

camp_npcs.name: Sergeant Niall
camp_npcs.greet: Captain Lir sent us to hold this camp. The Dergans will be back - when they come, Camp-Warden Dara will need every blade.
camp_npcs.idle: Keep an eye on the water. They always come by boat, and they always come at the worst time.

camp_npcs.name: Mag Mell guardsman
camp_npcs.idle: First time I've slept on this island without one eye open.

camp_npcs.name: Roane ferrywoman
camp_npcs.greet: The island camp? Hold on to me.
